current.text: He averaged 16 points, 8 rebounds and 6 assists with 2 threes per game in Summer League, but shot 26% from three.
He is not expected to start. He could get a solid role if Payton Pritchard comes off the bench.
Neither Boston preview lists him in the projected starting five or the main bench rotation. Pritchard comes off the bench in both.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players for about 10 spots, so some players miss out most nights.
He could have a double-digit season if Derrick White bounces back.
Jayson Tatum and Paul George take the top usage roles in Boston, which leaves less usage for the rest of the roster.
Boston is projected to win about 48 games.
Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league.

durable.text: He is a low-volume role player. He takes very few free throws, so his low FT% barely moves a team ratio.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo ranks him 208, ESPN ranks him 251, both sites value him at 0 USD, and we only draft 144 players. His projected line is about 22 minutes for 5.7 points and 0.9 assists, with no category that stands out. Watch the first weeks for minutes: if he gets into Boston's 10-man rotation, or Derrick White struggles, he is a waiver pickup for rebounds and low turnovers.
